title: Sensor restarts never work - Pixel 4 XL Transmitter 8H
symptom: Sensor restarts never work on Pixel 4 XL with Transmitter 8H. The user is unable to restart the sensor, even though they usually can with their Ticwatch Pro.
cause: The issue is specific to 81 - 8H transmitters. A new hardware/firmware version was discovered and coded as not being capable of preemptive restarts.
fix: Workaround: remove the transmitter from the sensor by unlatching it from the sides, wait 15 minutes, put it back in, and start the sensor again. Use an iFixit spudger or two old glucose test strips to safely unlatch.
evidence_quote: The only thing that works for me for now is removing transmitter from the sensor by unlatching it from the sides, waiting for 15 minutes, putting back in, and starting the sensor again.
